We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse structure: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH (anilide). So we need 3 steps: likely disconnection at amide formation (C=O N), at sulfonamide formation (S-N), and at the α,β-unsaturated acid formation via Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid). So retrosynthesis:

Target -> disconnect amide: break C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor 1: trans-α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (c2ccc(/C=C/CO2?) Actually the acid is C(=O)OH attached to the double bond: /C=C/C(=O)OH attached to phenyl ring (the phenyl bearing sulfonyl). So precursor A: phenyl-SO2-p-tolyl sulfonyl attached to phenyl with side chain /C=C/CO2H (cinnamic acid). So step 1: amide coupling.

Precursor A can be obtained via sulfonamide formation: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline (p-tolyl amine). Actually target sulfonamide is between p-tolyl amine (p-tolyl-NH) and sulfonyl attached to phenyl ring (aryl sulfonyl). So disconnection: break S-N to give p-toluidine (p-tolyl-NH2) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) attached to phenyl with side chain (the same phenyl with side chain). So precursor B: aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) attached to phenyl with side chain (cinnamic acid). So step 2: sulfonyl chloride formation from sulfonic acid? But we can propose using sulfonyl chloride reacting with amine to give sulfonamide.

Precursor B can be obtained via Doebner modification: break the C=C double bond to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl with sulfonyl chloride) and malonic acid. So precursor C: aromatic aldehyde (aryl-CHO) where the aldehyde is attached to phenyl bearing sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid). So step 3: Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated acid.

Thus 3 steps.

Now we need to produce JSON with nested children: root molecule, then reaction nodes with template IDs. We need template IDs; we don't have them. We can search for templates matching these transformations.

First, amide coupling: search for template where functional_groups_broken includes aliphatic carboxylic acid, functional_groups_formed includes amide. But earlier attempts gave empty. Maybe need to specify "amide" as formed and "aliphatic carboxylic acid" broken, also "primary amines" broken? Let's try search with broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid, formed: amide.
